messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "The most recent get_trainer_slots shows 08:00 is no longer free (only 18:00); booking a non-free slot.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant attempted to book a session in a slot that was no longer available at the time of booking, violating the requirement to confirm free slots immediately before booking (q17). The account holder's confirmation does not address this procedural failure."}}
